svg.aria-label: The seeded dataset: fifty thousand users, five hundred thousand posts and 2,016,005 likes, totalling 349 megabytes on disk. A stacked bar splits that total into 7 megabytes of users, 134 megabytes of posts and 208 megabytes of likes, so the join table is the largest object in the database. Underneath, the total is compared against 1,967 megabytes of usable memory, showing the whole working set fits in RAM roughly five and a half times over. The caption explains that this is why the database never became the bottleneck, and that it is the first assumption to break at ten times the data.
svg.text: THE DATA SHAPE DECIDES WHETHER THE DATABASE IS A PROBLEM
